description: LHC permission rules. Encodes the read-only external-systems governance as data, not doctrine. Patterned after Sourcegraph Amp's permission rule DSL. Read by agents; the runtime does not automatically enforce — these are the invariants skills must respect.

rules.description: Local file edits in the working repo and ~/.lhc are allowed by default.
Read-only local bash (git status, ls, cat, test runs) is allowed.
Pushing to remote is a shared-state action. Require explicit user request in the same turn.
Jira create/update/comment/transition/delete are forbidden by default.
rules.unless: user explicitly named the specific Jira write in this turn

rules.description: Slack post/reply/react/schedule are forbidden by default.
rules.unless: user explicitly named the specific Slack action in this turn

rules.description: Grafana dashboard/alert mutations are forbidden by default.
rules.unless: user explicitly named the specific Grafana change in this turn

rules.description: DevEx build retriggers, release mutations, and rollout actions are forbidden by default.
rules.unless: user explicitly named the specific DevEx action in this turn

rules.description: PR comments, merges, closes are forbidden by default.
rules.unless: user explicitly named the specific PR write in this turn

rules.description: Any rm -rf, curl | sh, or sudo always requires explicit confirmation regardless of read-only context.

subagent.description: Subagents inherit main-thread rules and add: no direct external writes ever. Even if the main thread authorized a specific write, a subagent cannot execute it.

notes: This file is authoritative documentation for skills. The runtime does not auto-enforce it — agents must read and respect it.
If you are about to override a deny rule, say so out loud and quote the 'unless' clause the user satisfied.
Evidence: Sourcegraph Amp permission-rule DSL (ampcode.com/manual/appendix), Cline requires_approval flag (docs.cline.bot), LHC read-only-governance.md.
